title: I made Space Dodge, a fast arcade space game for Android, and it's now live on Google Play
author: Old-Transition1744
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm a solo dev, and I just released my arcade game **Space Dodge** on Google Play.

The idea is simple: weave your ship through incoming space hazards, survive as long as you can and chase a higher score. You can pick it up in seconds, but it gets tough as the pace builds.

**What's in it:**

\- Quick, one-more-try arcade runs

\- A chill lofi soundtrack

\- Revives, so one mistake doesn't end a good run

\- Tuning to run smoothly even on lower-end phones

It's free to play, and I'd really love honest feedback on the difficulty, the controls, or anything that feels off. I'm still updating it regularly.

👉 [Get Space Dodge on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rtfgaming.spacedodge)

Thanks for checking it out, and drop your high score below!
